Politics · India

India to Secure Power Supplies Amid Peak Demand

The government is planning to procure medium-term power supplies to meet the country's peak-hour demand from January 2027 to December 2031. India's ACC battery demand is expected to reach 236 GWh by 2032, according to a minister's forecast. The country's peak power demand is projected to touch 300 GW next year.
